name: voxel-cube-assembly
description: Voxel cube assembly – Three.js motion graphic rendered with Remotion (4K compositions)

scripts.render:v1: remotion render VoxelCube-V1-4K "out/Version 1 - Voxel Cube Assembly (1080p).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:v2: remotion render VoxelCube-V2-4K "out/Version 2 - Voxel Cube Assembly - Graphite Amber Palette (1080p).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:v1:4k: remotion render VoxelCube-V1-4K "out/Version 1 - Voxel Cube Assembly (4K).mp4"
scripts.render:v2:4k: remotion render VoxelCube-V2-4K "out/Version 2 - Voxel Cube Assembly - Graphite Amber Palette (4K).mp4"
scripts.render:all: npm run render:v1 && npm run render:v2
